[LCMP.2.6.1] For each `call ... as <expr>` and each
`after <duration> as <expr>:` clause per [LRST.1.1], the
compiler must emit:

- The author-written expression.
- The expression's resolved type.
- The supersedure scope per [LRST.2.2]: `(rule, clause-position,
  evaluated-key)` for an `after`, `(service, evaluated-key)` for a
  `call` ([LCRS.6.2.1]).
- Compile errors if the type is `Json` per [LRST.1.4] or if
  the expression can be absent per [LRST.1.5].
